verdict.rationale: Basecamp's own feature docs say to-do lists support subtasks, which covers breaking work down. Nothing in the pack shows linking dependent tasks or making blocking order explicit, so only half the story is delivered, and that half rests on a single thin marketing mention. Missing for 10: task dependency/blocking links, any visualization of blocking order, in-depth subtask documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can break work into subtasks and link dependent tasks so blocking order is clear

citations.quote: Assign items, set due dates, attach files, even create subtasks.
